jobs.name: Verify reset, prune Kollekt
jobs.prompt:
One-off staging verification after the nightly demo reset, authorized by the user. Host `oci-public` (ssh oci-public). Never print credentials. Never use Stripe Checkout. Do not read, copy or edit `.env` files; a local permission policy blocks any command text containing `.env.` (for example `process.env.X` — write `process["env"]["X"]` instead). Change nothing except the Kollekt pruning described below. Do not commit or post to GitHub.

## Context
- Last night (2026-10-19 ~02:25 UTC) the donor backend was updated to ghcr.io/esamarathon/esa-dono-ui/backend@sha256:4c6027f3… (esa-dono-ui PR #204 rebased on dev, which includes PR #209: `POST /api/admin/channels` accepts a fixed `id`, and `seed-dev.sh` seeds Main Marathon = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101 and Bonus Stream = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000102; dev also includes PR #205: direct Wallet spends need `channel_id`, and the new seed-dev.sh sends it). Host deploy dir /home/ubuntu/projects/esa-dono-ui (seed-dev.sh and scripts/reset-demo.sh live there; reset-demo.sh now seeds through the first backend network that answers — PR #208).
- demo-reset.timer runs at ~04:00 UTC (`journalctl -u demo-reset.service`).
- Before the reset, the Channels had random ids: main-marathon = 68072323-47e5-42aa-8b8f-11d9f270671d, bonus-stream = fea82cfb-62c2-446d-8aff-671a717bd083. These are the last expected stale pair.
- Consumers: /home/ubuntu/projects/esa-consumers-staging (Kollekt api/web/db, overlay, gateway; reconcile timer rewrites the overlay cfg from the producer). Kollekt and the overlay poll the producer via the internal network esa-dono-pollers (172.29.47.0/28; kollekt-api 172.29.47.10, overlay 172.29.47.11; RATE_LIMIT_EXEMPT_IPS exempts them). The default Event id is 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.
- Read the earlier prune procedure and evidence in /var/lib/ai-workspace/.cache/pi-scratch/01a14987-b518-72e8-a664-75dc09151d99/staging-e2e/evidence-pass2/ (pruned-ids.txt and the scripts/notes there) and the skill /var/lib/ai-workspace/.pi/agent/projects-memory/esa-dono-ui/skills/deploy-staging-consumers/SKILL.md. Write all evidence to .../staging-e2e/evidence-pass4/.

## Tasks
1. Reset result: the journal shows "Demo reset COMPLETE" for today's run with no FAIL; the seed step (seed-dev.sh, including Wallet claims/votes with channel_id) and the prisma seed succeeded. If the reset is still running or the timer has not fired, wait (up to 30 min); if it failed, do NOT retry the reset — collect the journal and stop.
2. Producer state: GET /api/admin/channels (from inside the backend container with the admin key from its environment) shows main-marathon and bonus-stream with exactly the fixed ids above, active, on Event 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, which is active with primary_channel_id = …0101. Seeded incentives exist; the public /api/health is 200.
3. Consumers: reconcile timer ran and the overlay cfg/Replicants reference the fixed Channel ids (no restart loop; prefix guard OK); Kollekt api healthy (401 unauthenticated), RabbitMQ queues 1 consumer / 0 backlog; no 429s for 172.29.47.10/.11 in backend logs since the reset (avoid false matches like "4.4296ms").
4. Prune: in Kollekt's database, list all Campaigns with their producer ids and check each against the producer lookup (404 = stale). Expected stale: exactly the two old ids above (plus anything else that 404s — list it). Take a fresh pg_dump of Kollekt into .../staging-e2e/backup-pass4/ first, then delete only the Campaigns that 404 at the producer, using the same method as pass 2 (cascade to their donations etc.). Never delete Campaigns for the fixed ids or the Event id. Record before/after counts and Kollekt request rate to the producer before/after (requests/min from backend logs or Kollekt logs).
5. Report under 300 words: reset PASS/FAIL, fixed ids PASS/FAIL, consumers PASS/FAIL, what was pruned (ids, row counts), rollback material, anything unexpected.
